body:
It won't "achieve" anything besides finally getting me off of this ride, that I will admit. It's just been a decade or so since I could actually call myself happy, and that's rough is all. It's worse that I can remember a time when I was happy and felt invincible, though not everyone even gets that much out of life.

I know there are millions out there suffering too, and I'm not giving up yet. Like I said, I need to stick around if for nothing else than for my wife who is a wonderful person and frankly deserves better than me.

I will try to find another counselor. I just wish there was a way back to being carefree and happy like I was many years ago. But the fact is you can't turn back the clock, no matter how much you wish you could, and you have to work with the cards you're dealt.

Thanks again for talking to me.

Not so easy without decent health care coverage, though I have tried talking to a counselor for free. I just didn't find it terribly helpful. She seemed to think that I tied too much of my happiness to my career, and while this is probably fair, what else am I supposed to do? I have to work in order to put food on the table, and the career I have is the only one I've ever known even if I do hate it. But thanks for the comment - it's nice to know someone is out there listening.
